correctedCritiques.con-gospel-compositional-delay-and-sourc: Strongest feature: The argument distinguishes several concrete transmission uncertainties—compositional delay, unidentified sources, unknown contents, and authorial selection—while appropriately presenting them as limits on confidence rather than proof of unreliability. Principal limitation: It provides no comparative historical baseline or specific Gospel example showing unacceptable degradation across two generations, and it addresses Gospel transmission instead of the selected Pauline bodily-reading claim. Live burden: The skeptic must demonstrate how these uncertainties materially compromise particular resurrection traditions and outweigh early formulas, convergent sources, or ordinary ancient historiographical practice. Locked score: The strong band reflects central relevance, unusually precise and historically plausible uncertainty claims, explicit qualification, and charitable framing, tempered by indirect responsiveness and evidence that remains generalized rather than source-specific.
correctedCritiques.pro-gospel-patristic-source-convergence: Strongest feature: The move advances a cumulative method, connecting Pauline material, Gospel traditions, patristic testimony, and external markers so the affirmative case need not rest on one evidential strand. Principal limitation: The excerpt mainly questions whether competing groups derive from Jesus and gestures toward hostile markers, leaving patristic sourcing partially recoverable while not answering unknown-source, authorial-selection, copying, or independence objections. Live burden: The affirmative must identify the testimony, establish dating and informational independence, and show that convergence does not result from shared transmission or retrospective selection. Locked score: The mixed band reflects central relevance and useful cumulative architecture, but also incomplete target contact, sparse source specification, unstable scope, missing qualification, and argumentative force beyond what the evidence establishes.
